g=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in g_txt.splitlines()]
R,C=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if g[r][c]!=7 and (r,c) not in seen:
   stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
   while stack:
    rr,cc=stack.pop(); cells.append((rr,cc))
    for nr,nc in ((rr+1,cc),(rr-1,cc),(rr,cc+1),(rr,cc-1)):
     if 0<=nr<R and 0<=nc<C and g[nr][nc]!=7 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
      seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
   colors={g[rr][cc] for rr,cc in cells if g[rr][cc] not in (0,7)}
   comps.append((len(cells),min(cells),max(cells),colors,cells))
[(n,a,b,colors) for n,a,b,colors,cells in comps]
